prompt: Given the latest forecasts.json + markets.json + source_weights.json, compute the blended signal for every market and write signals.json.
expected_output: Reads the three input JSONs, calls compute_signal per market, writes signals.json atomically with p_blend / edge / f_size_raw / trade / reason for each market.

assertions.name: reads_three_inputs
assertions.description: Output must mention all three input files

assertions.name: calls_compute_signal
assertions.description: Output must reference the compute_signal function

assertions.name: explains_trade_flag
assertions.description: Output must explain when trade=true (edge>0.05 AND f_size_raw>0 AND before T-1h)
